@@U02876@@
Rape! And I? Do I count for nothing? The key is still in my hand! The key that led me through frightful seas of solitude here to secure ground! Here I have a footing. Here I face realities! Here is where spirit dares to fight with spirits to create the double kingdom wide as air! How far she was then, now she could not be nearer. I'll rescue her, and she will be mine twice over. Tl take the risk, I'll dare! Mothers! You Mothers! Grant that it be so! He who has known her can never live without her.

@@U02878@@
浮士德, what are you doing? 浮士德! Look at him! He seizes her by force, and already her form has begun to fade. He turns the key toward the boy now, it touches him! Aut! Au! Horrors! Gone! Gone!

@@U02879@@
(Explosion. 浮士德 lies on the floor. The spirits dissolve in vapor.)

@@U02881@@
(Throwing 浮士德 over his shoulder.)

@@U02882@@
Well, that’s life for you! Not even the Devil should bother himself with fools.

@@U02883@@
(Darkness. Tumult.)
translation:
@@U02876@@
强奸！而我呢？难道我就一文不值了吗？钥匙还在我手里呢！这把钥匙带领我穿过这里可怕的孤独之海，以确保安全！在这里我有了立足点。在这里我面对现实！在这里，神灵敢于与神灵战斗，创造广阔如空气的双重王国！那时她有多远，现在她已经无法再靠近了。我会救她，她就会再次属于我。我敢冒这个险！妈妈们！各位妈妈们！就这样吧！认识她的人永远无法没有她。

@@U02878@@
浮士德，你在做什么？ 浮士德！看看他！他用力抓住了她，她的形体已经开始褪色。他现在把钥匙转向男孩，这触动了他！啊！啊！恐怖！走了！走了！

@@U02879@@
（爆炸。浮士德躺在地板上。灵魂溶解在蒸汽中。）

@@U02881@@
（把浮士德扔到肩上。）

@@U02882@@
好吧，这就是你的生活！即使是魔鬼也不应该为愚人烦恼。

@@U02883@@
（黑暗。骚乱。）
